baselineFindings.interpretation: This receipt approves a future source allocation only. It does not claim that the Payroll consumer, durable storage or end-to-end TIM-007 flow already exists.

conditions: Authoring may begin only after a fresh central BASE-TFR-TIM-007 start token binds this receipt SHA-256 and the reviewed trust-packet SHA-256.
The new package may own only its inbox, quarantine, receipt, staging and materialized Payroll input abstractions; it must not write Time state or read Time storage.
The consumer must use direct TLS 1.3 mTLS plus exact RS256 workload JWT; gateway, browser, user, delegated and support identities are forbidden.

The consumer must independently verify tenant grant revision, policy revision, purpose, projection, result and handoff identity, worker and line counts, ordered sequence, sourceEntryDigest, sourceDigest, ruleDigest and payloadDigest before atomic finalization.
No partial or quarantined row may become calculation input, and refetch or receipt creation cannot release calculation.
The exact idempotency key is tenantId|closedTimeResultId|payloadDigest; same result with a different digest and same handoff with a different result are quarantined conflicts.
Time remains the sole canonical closed-result writer; Payroll remains the sole writer of its consumer-owned state.
Feature state remains default OFF with zero tenant enrollment and zero configured tenant grants.

mustNotCopyFromCompensationPlanPattern: Do not send snapshotRevision or payloadDigest as query parameters; TIM-007 permits no query parameters.
Do not couple jti to correlationId; correlationId is the stable XCON-011 lineage identity while every refetch attempt receives a separate fresh replay-protected jti.
Do not deserialize an unbounded XCON-008 result into an in-memory object graph before byte, compression-ratio, line-count and sequence limits are enforced.
Do not treat the event payload as result bytes or as calculation-release authority.
requiredNewConsumerBehavior: bounded decompression and incremental streaming verification before allocation
staged temporary rows with rollback and quarantine on every mismatch
atomic existing-receipt return for exact duplicate delivery
explicit reopen invalidation or retro lineage without rewriting finalized Payroll

forbidden: Payroll updates to close, result, handoff, Time receipt or Time outbox state
Time SQL or service writes to Payroll tables
a second writer or in-place rewrite of canonical XCON-008 results
calculation, preparation, release or statutory-output writes from this package

migrationBoundary.rule: Any durable Payroll table, RLS policy, grant, trigger or schema alteration requires a separate append-only HRIS-PAY migration decision and non-conflicting lease.
migrationBoundary.completionImpact: The source allocation can enter the TIM start token, but durable Payroll ingestion and combined TIM-007 end-to-end completion remain blocked until that separate decision exists.

mandatoryCases: feature absent or false creates no consumer, no transport and no tenant grant
exact TLS 1.3 mTLS SPIFFE identity and exact RS256 JWT pass while browser, gateway, header override, wrong workload, audience, purpose, projection, path, tenant and stale grant fail closed
stable correlationId and separate fresh jti are proven, and duplicate jti is denied before owner bytes are accepted
compressed and uncompressed byte ceilings, compression ratio, header, line and one-million-line ceilings apply before unbounded allocation
worker count, line count, zero-based implicit sequence, each sourceEntryDigest and all three result digests are verified incrementally
line gap, duplicate, count mismatch, identity mismatch and digest mismatch roll back staging and create quarantine evidence with no materialized input
same idempotency key and bytes return the original receipt, while same result with another digest and same handoff with another result quarantine
XCON-011 is only an exact owner-authored refetch trigger; envelope identity conflict, reopen handling and result-unknown recovery are covered
no Time database access, no Time write, no Payroll calculation release and no file outside the two approved globs
generated XCON-008 through XCON-011 source remains byte-identical
futureDatabaseCasesAfterSeparateMigratio: clean install and real upgrade for the newly leased Payroll migration
forced tenant isolation, append-only grants and no UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE for runtime identity
crash between staging and finalization leaves no calculation-visible partial input
concurrent identical and conflicting handoffs retain one deterministic receipt or quarantine conflict

executedTargetedEvidence.meaning: The pinned reusable security, digest, feature-default and generated-contract foundations pass; this is not evidence that the unimplemented TIM-007 consumer passes.

intentionalResidualGates: A fresh central TIM start token must bind this receipt and the trust packet before any closedtime source authoring or worktree materialization.
A separate PAY-owned migration decision is required before durable consumer persistence can be authored or runtime completeness claimed.
New closedtime negative, streaming, idempotency and single-writer tests must pass before module branch push or integration review.
Tenant enrollment, configured grants, production release and runtime activation remain separate later decisions.
